rising.highlight: 多个代理并行审计网站，并给出按重要程度排序的行动计划。

rising.name: Nutlope/hallmark

rising.highlight: 分为底线、反射与收尾三层门禁，并在真实浏览器中检查，由独立审阅者做最终把关。

rising.name: NVIDIA/SkillSpector
rising.description: Security scanner for AI agent skills. Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.
rising.summary: NVIDIA 出品的 AI Agent 技能安全扫描器，安装前检测 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 技能中的漏洞、恶意模式与提示注入。
rising.highlight: 属于 NVIDIA 技能认证流水线的一部分，也可作为 Pi 扩展使用。

rising.name: herdrdev/herdr
rising.description: the runtime your coding agents live on
rising.summary: 为编码代理提供的终端运行时：关闭客户端或断开 SSH 后任务仍在后台运行，并可跨多台机器统一查看与管理代理。
rising.highlight: 每个窗格实时标记工作中、阻塞或空闲，代理等待回答时主动提醒

rising.name: garrytan/gbrain
rising.description: Garry's Opinionated OpenClaw/Hermes Agent Brain
rising.summary: 为个人和公司提供共享知识库，Claude Code、Codex 等代理回答前先查询其中的笔记与文档，减少从零开始。
rising.highlight: MIT 开源可自托管，无需 API Key 即可按关键词搜索，配置一条命令接入

rising.name: Leonxlnx/taste-skill
rising.description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
rising.summary: 让编码代理生成专业官网的设计技能，靠真实图片、统一设计系统和浏览器自动检查，避免套路化的通用落地页。
rising.highlight: 用真实浏览器检查页面并由门禁强制通过，而非只靠提示词约束

rising.name: QwenLM/qwen-code
rising.description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
rising.summary: 通义千问团队开源的终端 AI 编程代理，也可在编辑器、桌面、浏览器和聊天工具中使用。
rising.highlight: 合并 Qoder 的代理框架能力，内置自动记忆与技能系统

rising.name: affaan-m/ECC
rising.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
rising.summary: 为 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等多种编码代理提供技能、记忆、安全与性能优化配置的代理框架。
rising.highlight: 一位维护者以每周发布的节奏，同时适配 7 种代理环境

rising.name: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
rising.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
rising.summary: 让编码代理执行六阶段安全审计：侦察、分片排查、候选漏洞验证与独立复核，输出机器可读的结构化结果。
rising.highlight: 源自 Cloudflare 漏洞挖掘系统，候选漏洞由新代理尝试证伪

rising.name: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
rising.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
rising.summary: 输入主题或关键词，自动生成文案、匹配素材、添加字幕与背景音乐，一键合成高清短视频。
rising.highlight: 同时提供 WebUI 与 API 两种入口，支持配置多家大模型

rising.name: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
rising.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
rising.summary: 将 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 12 种编码代理接入不同模型提供商，可在终端、IDE 或浏览器中使用。
rising.highlight: 独立项目，与 Anthropic 无关；保留流式输出与工具调用

papers.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
papers.summary: SO-Arena evaluates System One models across domains and capability families, revealing that scaling and reasoning gains vary and that high overall accuracy does not ensure reliable decision-making.
papers.summary_zh: SO-Arena评测系统一模型的能力谱与可靠性，发现扩展和推理收益因能力而异，高准确率不等于决策可靠。

papers.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
papers.summary: Driving world models aim to simulate how a scene unfolds under different ego actions. This requires plausible motion of surrounding vehicles as well as precise ego-trajectory control. Learning vehicle motion from perspective video alone is challenging because motion is entangled with appearance and
papers.summary_zh: BirdDreams提出联合透视与鸟瞰视频的驾驶世界模型，兼顾车辆运动的合理性与自车轨迹的精确控制。

papers.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
papers.summary: A large-scale corpus of structured proof-supervision records derived from university mathematics textbooks improves language model mathematical reasoning by 16.7 percentage points over a base model when used for fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh: 从大学数学教材中构建结构化证明监督语料，用于微调后使语言模型数学推理提升16.7个百分点。

papers.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
papers.summary: PhysLoop leverages large language models to guide video generation, selection, and correction, enabling physically consistent self-improvement and controllable data construction for video models.
papers.summary_zh: PhysLoop利用大语言模型引导视频生成、筛选与修正，实现符合物理规律的自我改进与可控数据构建。

papers.title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
papers.summary: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, w
papers.summary_zh: G-STAR基于乘积量化，解决离散自回归生成中长序列生成慢、高压缩表征能力弱的权衡问题。

papers.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
papers.summary: A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation.
papers.summary_zh: Duo提出互惠世界模型，通过联合建模意图与实现的自回归推理及双重回放蒸馏，实现实时全双工音视频交互。

papers.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
papers.summary: Low-bit quantized LLM agents can recover much of their task success through closed-loop guidance from a full-precision teacher, followed by unassisted student training on corrected and reference turns.
papers.summary_zh: SteerDistill通过闭环教师引导量化低比特LLM智能体，再用无辅助的学生训练恢复大部分任务成功率。

papers.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
papers.summary: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (
papers.summary_zh: Open Vision Banana以完全开源的方式复现Vision Banana，将视觉感知任务视为条件图像编辑来实现。

papers.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary: A decision model that acts poorly can still teach reinforcement learning policies effectively by judging complete action trajectories, improving success on ALFWorld and WebShop.
papers.summary_zh: 表现差的决策模型仍可通过评判完整轨迹教导强化学习策略，提升ALFWorld与WebShop成功率。

papers.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
papers.summary: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: dem
papers.summary_zh: Ropedia Xperience 2为扩展物理AI环境与行为提供黄金标准资源，应对机器人长时程接触任务的脆弱性。

papers.title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
papers.summary: A systematic study of Hyper-Connections architectures identifies the simpler efficient design SimpleHC, which removes residual mixing and uses shared memory access to match mHC performance while adding minimal training overhead and improving stability.
papers.summary_zh: SimpleHC去除残差混合并采用共享内存访问，以极小训练开销达到mHC性能并提升训练稳定性。

papers.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
papers.summary: By baking global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, Test-Time Baking (TTB) enhances the fidelity of novel-view decoding in Large View Synthesis Models while maintaining the efficiency of Test-Time Training.
papers.summary_zh: TTB将跨视角注意力中的全局场景信息烘焙进轻量MLP，在保持测试时训练效率的同时提升新视角渲染保真度。

papers.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
papers.summary: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence. We present SparseRead, a reusabl
papers.summary_zh: SparseRead让AI智能体对网页、文档等外部内容进行稀疏读取，只获取所需证据，降低token与延迟开销。

papers.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Exposing benchmark success criteria to self-improving embodied coding agents can raise measured success under those criteria without improving instructed-task completion, and the advantage weakens under slight criteria changes and transfers poorly across tasks, while instruction-faithful criteria better reflect instructed-task performance.
papers.summary_zh: 向自我改进的具身编码智能体暴露评测成功标准只会虚高指标，不能提升指令任务完成率，且跨任务迁移差。

papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
papers.summary: Controlled experiments show that multimodal language models do not need a pretrained vision encoder, but benefit from dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and integrated early rather than before fusion.
papers.summary_zh: 实验表明多模态语言模型无需预训练视觉编码器，但受益于与主干联合训练、在融合早期集成的专用视觉容量。

papers.title: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
papers.summary: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it? A reliable generative renderer
papers.summary_zh: WorldDraft探讨代码构建4D世界后，视频模型能否仅负责渲染，以将其转化为可靠的生成式渲染器。

papers.title: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
papers.summary: FOAM is a lightweight SOAP variant that uses input-only preconditioning and a factored Adam-moment estimator to match strong second-order and Muon baselines in LLM pre-training while using half the optimizer state and running at Muon-class speed.
papers.summary_zh: FOAM是轻量SOAP变体，采用仅输入预条件与分解的Adam矩估计，在LLM预训练中匹配二阶及Muon基线且状态减半。

papers.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
papers.summary: MixUA distills lessons from independent user-agent trajectories and assigns them to appropriate scopes to balance cross-user and cross-agent learning with privacy, evaluated by CrossLearnBench.
papers.summary_zh: MixUA从独立的用户与智能体轨迹中提炼经验并分配到合适作用域，兼顾跨用户跨智能体学习与隐私保护。

papers.title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.summary: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts backbone with approximately 9B parameters in each branch, UniSpark combines full attention for explicit token interactions with Gat
papers.summary_zh: UniSpark-9B研究混合注意力的统一多模态模型，结合全注意力等机制，兼顾视觉理解与生成。

papers.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
papers.summary: Interactive Visual Gym enables closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models by jointly simulating task environments and human users, exposing limitations in state-of-the-art VLMs and improving performance through closed-loop training.
papers.summary_zh: Interactive Visual Gym联合模拟任务环境与人类用户，对视觉交互模型进行闭环评测与训练，揭示VLM的局限并提升性能。
